releases.notes:
**Allied 2.0.0 is a big feature update.** Existing team data is upgraded automatically, so no setup changes are needed.

### New
- **Roles:** officer rank with `/allied promote` and `/allied demote`. Officers can invite, accept/deny requests, kick members and remove marks
- **Ownership transfer:** `/allied transfer <player>` (with confirmation). Admins can rescue abandoned teams with `/alliedAdmin transfer <team> <player>`
- **Offline invites:** invite, kick, accept and deny work for offline players. Pending invites and requests show up when they log in
- **Death coordinates:** your team sees where a member died (click to copy). Toggle with the `deathCoords` setting
- **Marks:** shared named coordinates with `/allied mark`, `/allied marks` and `/allied unmark`. No teleporting
- **Shared team storage:** `/allied storage` opens an 18-slot chest for the team
  - Only one player at a time
  - Saved on every change and duplication-safe, even if the server crashes
  - Every open and close is logged to `config/allied/storage/audit.log`
  - Disabled by default. Enable per team with `/alliedAdmin storage <team> true`, or for all teams with `/alliedAdmin storageAll true`
- `/allied info` now shows officers and offline members by name

### Notes
- Server-side only. Players don't need to install anything
- Requires Fabric API. Placeholder API is optional
- A team can't disband while its storage has items in it

releases.notes:
- **Updated to Minecraft 26.2** (Fabric Loader 0.19.5+, Fabric API)
- **Placeholder API support** (optional): `%allied:team_name%`, `%allied:team_tag%`, `%allied:team_color%`, `%allied:team_prefix%`, `%allied:team_members%`
- **Highlight** now shows invisible teammates with a glowing outline, visible only to your own team
- **`/alliedAdmin exportJson <true|false>`** exports all teams to `config/allied/teams.json` so you can show them on a website

**Fixes**
- Creating a team with an existing name no longer overwrites that team
- Allied no longer deletes vanilla `/team` teams or other mods' scoreboard teams
- `/alliedAdmin memberCap` and the other config commands now work from the console
- The [DENY] join button, the admin settings buttons, and invite buttons for team names with spaces now work
- Accepting requests/invites respects the member cap and can't put a player in two teams
- Team chat messages are no longer lost after leaving a team
- Renaming a team keeps its admin settings block
- Team data is saved safely so a crash can't corrupt it

Closes #13, #11, #7, #4
